Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan ban on building is most likely treated as an equitable servitude enforceable against successors with notice, since negative easements are traditionally limited to light, air, support and water flow.

Q5623.reason: The broadcast covered a newsworthy public protest and gave opinion about a public figure, so it is constitutionally privileged and the privacy claim fails.

Q5004.reason: The class gift to the sister's children who reach 25 can vest too remotely, because a child born at the sister's death would reach 25 more than 21 years after any life in being, so the Rule Against Perpetuities voids it and the friend holds the lot alone.
